clues: This old farm village sits on a high flat plain. It lies northwest of Innsbruck, between two grand mountain ranges.
Cold months are for skiing down steep slopes. Warm months are for walking trips through the high hills.
The first known record of this old farm village dates all the way back to the year 1022.
This small village has hosted events for the Winter Olympics more than once. That is a huge feat for a place so small.
Ski fans know this spot as the home of Anton Seelos. He gave the world the parallel turn.
